experiment: B3 — BEVFormer-tiny FP32 mAP on nuScenes v1.0-mini val
machine: AI-LAP / RTX 3080 10GB, driver 595, CUDA 12.8 (torch cu117 backward-compat)
eval_set: v1.0-mini val split = 81 keyframes from 2 scenes (NOT the 6019-sample full val)
command: python -m torch.distributed.launch --nproc_per_node=1 tools/test.py bevformer_tiny.py <ckpt> --launcher pytorch --eval bbox --cfg-options data.workers_per_gpu=0
caveat: 81-sample / 2-scene MINI SMOKE, high variance. mAP≈official is coincidental; NDS 0.267 vs official 0.354 and 3 classes at exactly 0.000 (absent/undetected in 2 mini scenes) prove this is a smoke test, not a benchmark. Only relative FP32↔INT8 deltas on the SAME mini slice would be meaningful.
